title: Prescription Diet Autoship for a Pet Already on a Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscription
content:
**Pharmacy enrollment desk — prescription diet subscriptions**

This rule sets the bag count per shipment of a new Autoship Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship for a pet's Rx Prescription Diet prescription when the pet already has an Autoship Pharmacy subscription in its name, written as the new subscription's quantity. The new subscription ships on the same weeks between shipments as that existing prescription Autoship, and its first ship date is the date the customer chooses.

The bag count of a prescription diet Autoship that ships alongside the pet's medication Autoship is not fixed until the weeks between that medication Autoship's shipments have been re-timed under its current package count.

A prescription diet Autoship for a pet is not set up before the shared household food Autoship the pet has been eating from has been re-timed for the pets that stay on it.

The new subscription is an enrollment like any other and meets the Tailwise Autoship enrollment conditions and the rules on holding several subscriptions per customer, item and pet.

## Opening the subscription: `enroll_rx_autoship_732fccd3`

**Capability.** Opens a new Autoship Pharmacy subscription in the customer's own name for one prescription item kept on file for one of their pets. On success a new subscription is created in status `pending_first_shipment`, linked to the pet and to the prescription, carrying the item number, description and price per package given, the packages per shipment, the weeks between shipments and the first ship date given, with nothing billed yet. The customer sees the new subscription and its reference number at once; the first shipment is charged on the first ship date.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the customer: it authorizes recurring charges on the customer's card. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | The customer reference number of the account the subscription is opened on, from the customer profile lookup | Id |
| `pet_id` | The reference number of the pet the prescription is written for, from the pet profiles lookup | Id |
| `rx_prescription_id` | The reference number of the prescription kept on file that the subscription fills, from the prescriptions lookup | Id |
| `sku` | The item number of the package dispensed under the prescription | TW- followed by 6 digits, exactly as the prescription record shows it |
| `item_description` | The medication or diet name exactly as the prescription record shows it in its medication field | Verbatim, character for character, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion |
| `unit_price_usd` | The catalog price of one package in USD | Number with 2 decimal places, exactly as the prescription record shows it; no rounding is applied by the tool |
| `quantity` | The packages each shipment carries | Integer, whole packages |
| `frequency_weeks` | The number of weeks between shipments | Integer, whole weeks |
| `next_ship_date` | The first ship date the customer chose | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, store-local, no time part |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with six fields: `autoship_id` (the new subscription's reference number), `variant_name` (always `Autoship Pharmacy`), `status` (always `pending_first_shipment`), `quantity`, `frequency_weeks` and `next_ship_date`. A returned `autoship_id` with status `pending_first_shipment` is the success receipt.
